variants.name: 08 — Ritme
variants.refinement_prompt: One consistency correction to this finished 08 / RITME moodboard. Use the large UPRIGHT hero revive wordmark as the exact master design: horizontal segmented r stem, solid upright evive and red square i dot. Correct every SMALL wordmark in the logo-specimen row, website, mobile, proposal and pen so it uses this same UPRIGHT lettering, not italic/slanted letters. The r icon also stays upright with its horizontal bands. In the THIRD small wordmark specimen on light background, make the entire wordmark including i dot black as the monochrome example; other wordmarks retain red i dots. Do not alter hero, photography, layouts, slogans, palette, graphics or any non-logo text. Keep everything else as shown; same 1536x1024 complete moodboard.
variants.label: 08 / RITME
variants.description: Horizontale lijnen verdichten zich tot een heldere r. Hetzelfde ritme keert terug in documentregels, fotokaders en grafische vlakken.
variants.detail:
DIRECTION "08 / RITME": HORIZONTAL FADER. Upright, substantial neo-grotesk lowercase wordmark with open counters, a quieter confident financial feel. The FIRST r retains a solid shoulder and has a stem formed by 5 clean HORIZONTAL bands; narrow negative gaps between bands progressively reduce towards the solid upper shoulder, so the r feels assembled from rhythm into a complete letter. The other five letters evive are solid, with a red square i dot. Recognizable readable r; do not turn it into a flag or E. No slant in this variant.
Derived graphic language: horizontal line fields of gradually changing thickness forming a restrained rectangular reveal, calm ledger-like rules that resolve into solid panels. A very large cropped abstract r-line detail on a carbon panel shows the geometry. Photo reveals only at one edge, never covering people. Business photography natural colour, mature adviser and entrepreneur in a bright contemporary meeting room.
Palette swatches exactly: "Carbon #202020", "Rood #D92D20", "Papier #F6F4EE", "Grijs #969A9C". Carbon/paper dominant, red reserved for i dot and small purposeful graphic markers; no orange in this variation.
Layout: main large wordmark on paper at upper left, financial statement/photo pairing to right; strong horizontal section rhythm, foundations row and elegantly rendered website/mobile/proposal below. Make the horizontal fader unmistakable IN THE r itself and echoed in graphics. Minimal high-confidence institutional editorial design.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE complete, original brand-identity moodboard for Dutch business-finance brand "revive", 1536x1024 landscape.
Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE for faders: solid forms partially revealed through deliberate stepped parallel lines, rhythm and segmentation. Do not copy its actual logos, names or shapes.
Image 2 is BRAND CONTEXT: revive's confident wordmark, red i-dot, finance applications and business setting. Create a distinct new variation, not a copy of its layout.

BRAND RULES: lowercase six-letter name r-e-v-i-v-e; first r integrated into the name at equal body height, never a separate icon before a repeated r. A single RED #D92D20 square dot over the i, NO coloured accent inside r. The proposed fader cuts are negative-space linework, never a coloured r dot. Legibility is critical. Limit logo fader detail to 4–6 meaningful parallel cuts/bands, substantial solid letter structure, not a fragile all-over barcode. Consistent same logo in hero, reverse, monochrome, icon and applications. Isolated r icon derives from the first letter; show a simplified small-size version with fewer cuts as needed. Mono specimen entirely one ink including i dot.
Tone: established, capable, assertive contemporary finance; measured forward progress. No cars, racing livery, sports badges, neon, fake certification, padlocks, bank-column clichés, stock charts or healthcare softness. Geometry comes from the letter's fader system and is used intentionally in frames, section rules and photo reveals. Never cross faces/text with stripes.

FULL BOARD: generous large logo hero; reverse and mono wordmark specimens and small app icon; four palette swatches; GT Eesti Display UPRIGHT supporting typography specimen (Aa / 0123456789); a clear dedicated graphic-elements panel with the parallel-line geometry expanded at two scales; consistent simple line icons; credible business-owner/adviser photography in a contemporary office with laptop and proposal; editorial brand statement; website, mobile and printed financing proposal applications. Aim for a beautifully coherent design presentation with generous margins and crisp typography, not clutter. Let the line geometry organize panels while maintaining clean reading areas. Use a different deliberate composition for this new concept.

Finance applications show orderly labels "Financieringsbedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag" with em-dash placeholders, clear "Bekijk voorstel" action, and "Je contactpersoon"; no fabricated amounts/rates or personal details. Three-step process "01 Aanvraag", "02 Beoordeling", "03 Voorstel".
EXACT SLOGANS, both large enough to read, no other marketing lines:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."

LEAVE unused text areas BLANK. NO slogans such as Samen verder, fake addresses, invented filler paragraphs, credentials or certification claims. Full original moodboard, precise restrained faders, visible human business context.

variants.name: 09 — Stroom
variants.label: 09 / STROOM
variants.description: Schuine parallelle snedes geven de r richting. Het licht vooroverhellende woordmerk en afgeleide lijnvlakken brengen gecontroleerde beweging in het systeem.
variants.detail:
DIRECTION "09 / STROOM": DIAGONAL FADER. Refined moderately forward-slanted bold lowercase wordmark, about 10–12 degree lean, controlled motion with financial credibility. The first r is a readable solid shape with 4 parallel DIAGONAL negative-space slits rising 45 degrees from lower-left toward upper-right, confined to the lower-left portion of its stem; the upper-right shoulder resolves into a fully solid form. Keep at least 65% of r solid. Remaining evive completely solid; red square i-dot. No separate monogram, no duplicate r.
Derived graphic language: broad abstract rectangular corner forms built from diagonal parallel bands which become thinner toward one edge; one deliberate diagonal edge-reveal on a cropped office photo. NOT race stripes, no swooshes or speed clouds. Use smooth paper/ink-blue blocks, spacious straight text columns, precision rather than spectacle.
Palette exactly: "Inkt #172E46", "Rood #D92D20", "Wit #FFFFFF", "Leisteen #788A9A".
Business photos: calm focused discussion between a business owner and financial adviser, professionally dressed, natural daylight in a contemporary office; subtle cool natural colour.
Composition: large reverse white wordmark on an ink-blue hero field; a paper financial headline panel and business photo beside it, with the diagonal geometry used once prominently. Separate generous logo/graphics specimens and all required full finance applications. Ensure it is visually distinct from the horizontal variation. Main impression: composed forward momentum.

variants.name: 10 — Inzicht
variants.refinement_prompt: One consistency correction to this finished 10 / INZICHT moodboard. Use the large UPRIGHT hero revive wordmark as the exact master: vertical segmented r stem merging into a solid shoulder, upright solid evive, red square i dot. Correct every SMALL wordmark in the logo row, website, mobile, proposal, stationery and pen so it uses the same UPRIGHT lettering, not italic/slanted letters. The r icon also stays upright with vertical segments. In the THIRD small wordmark specimen on light background, make all letters AND i dot black for the monochrome example; all other wordmarks keep red i dots. Do not alter hero, photos, layout, slogans, palette, graphics or any non-logo text. Everything else unchanged; same 1536x1024 full moodboard.
variants.label: 10 / INZICHT
variants.description: Verticale segmenten onthullen de r. Smalle kolommen en rustige uitsneden vertalen die vorm naar overzichtelijke financiële toepassingen.
variants.detail:
DIRECTION "10 / INZICHT": VERTICAL REVEAL. Upright confident slightly narrower lowercase wordmark with open counters and sophisticated contemporary grotesk lettering. First r is a strong recognizable letter built with 5 VERTICAL parallel segments of staggered length that merge into its solid rounded shoulder. The outer r silhouette is clear, lower vertical gaps are wide enough to see and limited so the letter remains readable. The remaining evive solid and crisp. One red square i-dot. No coloured mark inside the r, no separate emblem. Emphasise segmentation and reveal, not speed; this variant is upright and dependable.
Derived graphic language: vertical line modules with stepped upper/lower ends revealing rectangular windows, inspired by controlled shutters; orderly information columns and narrow document edge patterns. Large subtle tone-on-tone vertical fader on forest-green background. Never a fingerprint, sound equalizer, building skyline, barcode or trading chart.
Palette exactly: "Bosgroen #173D36", "Rood #D92D20", "Ivoor #F7F5EE", "Steen #929B91". Deep forest and ivory dominant with red tiny accents; no mint/pastel/wellness cues.
Photography: natural-colour understated professional business-finance conversation, medium shot of two experienced people reviewing a proposal in an office, warm neutral light.
Composition: broad ivory logo/statement panel paired with a dark forest graphic panel and a vertical-format business photo; foundations arranged in orderly columns. Polished website on desktop, mobile financing summary, and a forest/ivory printed proposal demonstrate the vertical rhythm. Distinct from both the horizontal and diagonal alternatives. Mature, assertive, restrained original identity.
